# Code of conduct

This project follows the
[Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind, assume good faith, criticise the work rather than the person,
and remember that the person on the other end may be working in a second
language. Harassment, personal attacks and publishing someone's private
information are not tolerated.

Report unacceptable behaviour privately to the maintainer through
email, [jesvi22j@gmail.com](mailto:jesvi22j@gmail.com), or by a private security report (see
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Reports are kept confidential. The maintainer may
remove comments, issues or contributions, and may block anyone who breaks this
code.
